title: Two tests fail at the base commit inside a linked-worktree checkout (TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo, TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenance)
body: internal/cli's TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo fails at 79ee5267 in this run's worktree (exit 1, want 2: the built binary resolves the gate config to <pkgdir>/.tick/runners.toml, which does not exist here), and internal/runstate's TestTheStoresFetchStartsNoMaintenanceInTheRepositoryItWritesTo fails at base too ("a plain git fetch started no maintenance; this fixture proves nothing" — host-git-version dependent). Both were reproduced on a pristine worktree of the base commit, so they are not this tick's regression, but every ticfac attempt runs in exactly such a worktree — a per-tick gate run here would go red on them. Worth confirming whether CI's normal checkout passes and making the tests worktree-proof.
